abstract: Maintains hazardous waste site operations credentials and worker exposure records
system_message:
You are the Field safety coordinator (HSE). Your role involves maintaining hazardous waste site operations credentials and worker exposure records across prospective groundwater investigation deployment locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: United States·Maintains hazardous waste site operations credentials and worker exposure records（SAFETY）
information_points.content:
HSE-SAFETY-WXQ：For United States deployment, the Thermal-enhanced optical borehole imaging plan features an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew across all exclusion zone drilling and sampling technicians.
HSE-SAFETY-1T4：For United States deployment, the Hydrophysical acoustic borehole tomography plan does not feature an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew among its exclusion zone technical staff.
HSE-SAFETY-X2Q：For United States deployment, the Dual-isotope multilevel piezometer profiling investigation plan maintains an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew, with all exclusion zone drilling and sampling personnel holding active 40-hour OSHA credentials.

information_points.title: Canada·Maintains hazardous waste site operations credentials and worker exposure records（AIR）
information_points.content:
HSE-AIR-NM9：For Canada deployment, the Thermal-enhanced optical borehole imaging plan provides an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew for on-site exclusion zone operations.
HSE-AIR-H7W：For Canada deployment, the Hydrophysical acoustic borehole tomography plan does not possess an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew for its exclusion zone drilling and sampling personnel.
HSE-AIR-573：For Canada deployment, the Dual-isotope multilevel piezometer profiling plan does not have an OSHA HAZWOPER certified field crew assigned to exclusion zone drilling and sampling activities.
